title: A guided data-quality workflow
text: Open Cleaning → Missing data. Deal tab offers row removal, filling values , mean replacement, median replacement kNN imputation. Select variables intend change inspect result clicking Apply cleaning. Compare row removal median replacement weight_kg. Use Reset original data alternatives. Ask many cats remain whether weight distribution changes. following R example deliberately changes one variable keeps original dataset: Mean median replacement useful teaching comparisons, fills gap single value understates uncertainty. analytical work, consider multiple imputation mice::mice() assumptions appropriate, pool analysis across imputations. interpret filled values newly observed data. code: complete_weights <- cat_data |>   filter(!is.na(weight_kg))  median_filled <- cat_data |>   mutate(weight_kg = replace_na(weight_kg, median(weight_kg, na.rm = TRUE)))  comparison_data <- bind_rows(   "Observed weights" = complete_weights,   "Median replacement" = median_filled,   .id = "method" )  method_summary <- comparison_data |>   summarise(     n_cats = n(),     mean_weight_kg = mean(weight_kg),     median_weight_kg = median(weight_kg),     .by = method   ) method_summary #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   method             n_cats mean_weight_kg median_weight_kg #>   <chr>               <int>          <dbl>            <dbl> #> 1 Observed weights       28           6.55             4.45 #> 2 Median replacement     31           6.35             4.45

title: A guided data-quality workflow
text: Open Cleaning → Outliers. Inspect boxplot flagged variables. app uses interquartile range (IQR) rule: lower fence=Q1−1.5×IQR,upper fence=Q3+1.5×IQR. \text{lower fence} = Q_1 - 1.5 \times \mathrm{IQR},\qquad \text{upper fence} = Q_3 + 1.5 \times \mathrm{IQR}. flag identifies unusual value; prove value wrong. Check units, source records group cat belongs. Compare Remove extreme values Winsorize extreme values app. Removal changes sample. Winsorizing keeps row caps value fence. Keep record rule affected observations.
code: weight_quartiles <- quantile(cat_data$weight_kg, c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE) weight_iqr <- diff(weight_quartiles) lower_fence <- unname(weight_quartiles[1] - 1.5 * weight_iqr) upper_fence <- unname(weight_quartiles[2] + 1.5 * weight_iqr)  flagged_weights <- cat_data |>   filter(!is.na(weight_kg), weight_kg < lower_fence | weight_kg > upper_fence) flagged_weights |>   select(id, name, weight_kg) #> # A tibble: 4 × 3 #>   id    name     weight_kg #>   <chr> <chr>        <dbl> #> 1 a01   Dazhuang       9.2 #> 2 a04   Shane          7.9 #> 3 a08   Stanley       56   #> 4 a28   Kathryn        1.8

title: cataScience 2.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-11-05 Added shared two-cat navbar icon favicon based maintainer’s cats, larger circular mark app launchers. website uses cat favicon retains original hex logo. Added run_catas() extended workshop; run_cata() remains original entry point. workflow connects review, audited joins, explicit denominators, charts communication, input snapshots undo. Added reusable import, profile, missingness, key-check, outlier-flag, join, proportion status-summary functions, plus documented examples. Added cata_plot() 11 chart types theme_cata(), offline HTML report/dashboard exports. Project exports include reproducible R, Quarto Shiny sources, input snapshots preparation records. Added data matters, John Snow’s map, care-cascade lesson synthetic Lao workshop B/C analysis. Kept AI chart comparison external classroom exercise. Kept mice cat Easter egg added multiple imputation, diagnostic chains pooled model estimates using synthetic cats. Removed rio. Made VIM optional kNN; replaced missingness chart mice. Kept naniar/skimr optional DSIR theme. Fixed classic outlier removal source columns beginning shadow_ preserved. Added explicit UTF-8 loading nested app scripts. Revised quiz explanations distinguish review flags errors missingness assumptions conclusions established observed data.

title: cataScience 2.1.4
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-06 Added three vignettes covering installation launch, reproducible data-quality workflow, guidance running training session. Added pkgdown documentation website, linked package metadata README, function reference searchable articles. Added package hex logo based maintainer’s two cats, displayed README, website vignettes.

Rendering text writes nothing; generated HTML unchanged.
